evidence.quote: were likely to warrant exceptionally low rates for an extended period
Participants agreed that underlying inflation currently was subdued and was likely to remain so for some time.
The weakness in labor markets continued to be an important concern to meeting participants, who generally expected unemployment to remain elevated for quite some time.
Overall, many participants viewed the risks to their inflation outlooks as being roughly balanced.
he proposed, as an interim approach, continuing the practice of not reinvesting the proceeds of maturing agency securities or MBS prepayments.
Committee members and Board members agreed that there had been substantial improvements in the functioning of financial markets
